title: Gate Lodge, Kilcarra West, Glenart Castle, Kilcarra, Co. Wicklow, Y14E785

description:
-A Very Rare and Unique Heritage Residence in the Heart of the Vale of Avoca

-2 Bedrooms & 2 Bathrooms on over 0.35 acres

-Retaining Many Of Its Original Architectural Features

-Extensively Restored in the early 2000s

-Private Mature Gardens fully enclosed by Stone and Wrought Iron Railings


Nestled at the historic entrance to the 18th century Glenart Castle Estate, this enchanting two-bedroom, two-bathroom gate lodge presents a rare opportunity to acquire a truly distinctive period residence in one of County Wicklow's most picturesque settings. Originally constructed in c.1890 as the gate lodge to this renowned estate by the Earl of Carysfort, William Proby, the property combines timeless architectural character with the tranquillity and natural beauty for which the Vale of Avoca is celebrated.

Sitting on over 0.35 acres, this propertys unique design reflects the craftsmanship and heritage associated with the castle itself retaining many of its original architectural features, including traditional and decorative stone construction, period Gothic detailing and includes a bartizan and round tower to the rear. 

Approached by entering underneath the original impressive castle archway the gate lodge entrance is accessed through two large wrought iron gates with large stone pillers either side into a gravel drive parking area. The lodge itself is accessed through an original solid wood front door featuring studs and strap hinges into a charming circular entrance porch with chequerboard black and white floor tiles. The ground floor livingroom, is spacious, warm and inviting with solid wood flooring and a feature fireplace with wood buring stove. To the left is a kitchen/breakfast room overlooking the rear garden with shaker style cabinetry, mosaic design backspash tiles and a traditional tiled floor. The downstairs accommodation is completed by a downstairs bathroom with black and white checkerboard floor tiles. 

Upstairs comprises a large master bedroom with solid wood floors and exposed wooden roof beams together with a wood burning stove with a brick wall surround. The adjacent ensuite bathroom is located within the architectural round tower which provides for a unique circular floor-to-ceiling tiled walk-in shower with antique hardware and showerhead. The second bedroom comprises sloped ceilings with solid wood floors and overlooks the rear garden through period leaded quarry windows.

Outside, the well maintained gardens are extensive featuring a suntrapped patio, wooden bridge, three Victorian style lamp posts, and a barbecue grill area all enclosed by a stone and wrought iron railing perimeter ensuring privacy and security. 

Situated in Woodenbridge between Avoca and Arklow, this property enjoys an enviable position amidst rolling countryside, mature woodland, and the breathtaking landscapes of the Vale of Avoca. The immediate surrounding area offers scenic walks, river valleys, golf courses, and some of the most beautiful countryside in Ireland. Located only 1.5 hours from Dublin Airport and/or Rosslare this property is an ideal holiday home in the heart of the Garden of Ireland and also offers excellent investment opportunities for those who want to secure a unique, period residence that combines architectural character, historical appeal and enduring market demand.
